title: Amarnath Yatra resumes after six-day suspension
summary: The Amarnath Yatra resumed on [date] after a six-day suspension. On [date], 6269 pilgrims left Jammu for Baltal, marking the resumption of the yatra. The pilgrims were part of the 19th convoy to leave Jammu for Baltal. The government had suspended the yatra due to security concerns and heavy rainfall in the region. The suspension was lifted after the authorities assessed the situation and ensured the safety of the pilgrims.
